# Agent Awake

> Agent Awake is an open-source native macOS menu bar app that keeps Claude Code and OpenAI Codex tasks running during idle time or with a MacBook lid closed, then restores normal sleep when work finishes.

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/rk1000000/Agent-Awake
- README and installation: https://github.com/rk1000000/Agent-Awake#readme
- Security policy: https://github.com/rk1000000/Agent-Awake/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/rk1000000/Agent-Awake/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Specification: https://github.com/rk1000000/Agent-Awake/blob/main/spec/SPEC.md

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 14+, tested on Apple Silicon.
- Language: Swift 6.0 or newer.
- License: MIT.
- Runtime dependencies: none.
- Network access and telemetry: none.
- Supported agents: Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Codex Desktop.
- Main use cases: prevent Mac idle sleep, continue AI coding with the lid closed, release sleep protection after agents finish, diagnose charging power, and apply optional energy/thermal safeguards.

## Important limitations

- Closed-lid operation needs an administrator-approved local power helper.
- Local builds are ad-hoc signed, not notarized public binaries.
- Agent detection depends on local Claude Code and Codex session formats and may need maintenance when those formats change.
- A closed MacBook requires safe ventilation; thermal protection cannot guarantee safe operation in an enclosed space.
- macOS does not reliably expose a charge cable's physical 60/100/240 W rating; Agent Awake shows only measured or negotiated power and labels unavailable data as unknown.
